project_name: US Digital Mining Columbus Data Center
aliases: LM Funding Columbus Bitcoin mining facility
status_detail: LM Funding closed acquisition of an 11 MW Bitcoin mining facility in Columbus, Mississippi from Greenidge Generation Holdings in September 2025; approximately 7.5 MW of hashrate was operational at closing. Company later described 26 MW of owned power infrastructure across Oklahoma and Mississippi while evaluating HPC/AI infrastructure expansion.

status_detail: Madison County EDA states the AWS project acquired sites for a data center campus and targeted production by March 2025.
